notes: Entry four: the science, and the sick bay's hologram earning a plot
**Their chemistry is correct and only the attribution is wrong**, and
that distinction is the whole design of the misdirection. The Doctor
says so himself -- he can support the chemistry and not the author --
so the tape carries its own correction and a second watch finds it.
He is right, she overrules him, and she is the one who is wrong.
title: Personal Log -- Entry Four
subtitle: Lt. Lucy Shepard and the Emergency Medical Hologram
author: recorded aboard this shuttle

lines.text: PERSONAL LOG -- ENTRY FOUR
DAY 146 -- FOUR JULY
I have been running samples. I am not a physician.
So I turned the EMH on. He has been on ever since.
Please state the nature of the-- yes. Hello, Lieutenant.
He does that every time. I stopped asking him not to.
-- WHAT IT IS --
It is not a virus in the sense you are using the word.
It is engineered. I am being careful with that word.
Nothing in it is accidental. There is no waste in it.
Explain that part for the recording.
Nature is wasteful. This is not. Somebody edited it.
-- WHAT IS STRANGE --
There are morphogenic markers all through the structure.
Shapeshifter biology. Not humanoid. Not viral. Changeling.
Changelings?
The scaffold is a morphogenic pathogen. I am confident.
The payload attacks humanoid neural tissue. Also confident.
Those two things do not belong in one organism.
-- WHAT WE THINK IT MEANS --
There is exactly one morphogenic pathogen on record.
Section 31 built it. They used it on the Founders.
Well obviously someone has rebuilt it.
So they kept it. Of course they kept it. And improved it.
Then they found a world with no witnesses and tried it.
That is one conclusion. I can only support the chemistry.
I cannot support the author.
Noted. Recorded. I still think I am right.
If I am wrong about who, I am not wrong about what.
-- ENTRY FOUR ENDS --
Lieutenant. You have been awake for twenty-six hours.
Goodnight, Doctor.
Goodnight, Lucy.
